The '''Myrialites''' were a group of separatist [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdans]] during the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]] ([[3970 BBY]]&mdash;[[3670 BBY]]). They were led by the Provisional Governor [[Myrial]] and were based in the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]]. During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the Myrialites seceded from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], denouncing it as corrupt and faithless. After conquering the Kanz sector, they established an independent state known as the [[Argazdan Redoubt]].

During the Kanz Disorders, they subjugated and enslaved the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdians]] to punish them for supporting the [[Amaltanna/Legends|Amaltannan]] resistance. The Myrialites forbade their Lorrdian slaves from speaking, forcing them to develop a secret language involving subtle body gestures known as [[kinetic communication]]. In [[3670 BBY]], the Myrialites were defeated by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Republic forces under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mari-Elan Nora]].
